source: 高级启动入口仅供查看，不能在此更改。
en: Advanced startup entries are read-only here.

source: 本机高级入口
en: Machine advanced entry

source: 当前用户高级入口
en: Current-user advanced entry

source: 已读取注册配置；条件是否满足及实际启用状态未验证。
en: Registered configuration found; conditions and effective enabled state have not been verified.

source: 高级注册表入口读取不完整：{0}（{1}）。
en: Advanced registry inventory is incomplete: {0} ({1}).

source: 高级来源 {0} 达到 {1} 项读取上限。
en: Advanced source {0} reached its {1}-entry limit.

source: 某个高级注册表视图不可读，已保留其他来源。
en: An advanced registry view could not be read; other sources are retained.

source: WMI 永久订阅
en: Permanent WMI subscriptions

source: 打包应用启动声明
en: Packaged app startup declarations

source: 高级启动来源达到数量或时间边界，结果可能不完整。
en: Advanced startup inventory reached its size or time limit; results may be incomplete.

source: {0} 的上次系统读取尚未结束，本次未重复请求。
en: The previous system read for {0} is still pending; no duplicate request was started.

source: {0} 读取超时，系统调用可能仍在完成，当前保留其他来源。
en: Reading {0} timed out. The system call may still be completing; other sources are retained.

source: {0} 读取失败（{1}），已保留其他来源。
en: Could not read {0} ({1}); other sources are retained.

source: 本机 WMI 订阅
en: Local WMI subscription

source: WMI 条件事件
en: Conditional WMI event

source: 只读取订阅绑定；未验证条件或执行结果。脚本正文未读取。
en: Subscription binding only; conditions and execution are not verified. Script bodies are not read.

source: WMI 来源达到读取上限，部分对象未显示。
en: WMI inventory reached its limit; some objects are omitted.

source: WMI 某类对象不可读（{0}），关联信息可能不完整。
en: A WMI object class could not be read ({0}); associations may be incomplete.

source: WMI 命名空间 {0} 不可读（{1}）。
en: WMI namespace {0} could not be read ({1}).

source: WMI 仅读取 root\subscription 与 root\default；其他命名空间未扫描。
en: WMI inventory covers root\subscription and root\default only; other namespaces are not scanned.

source: 打包启动来源达到读取上限，部分声明未显示。
en: Packaged startup inventory reached its limit; some declarations are omitted.

source: 某个包清单过大，启动声明未读取。
en: A package manifest is too large; its startup declarations were not read.

source: 某个包已达到 100 项启动声明读取边界。
en: A package reached the limit of 100 startup declarations.

source: 某个打包启动声明不可读（{0}），已保留其他包。
en: A packaged startup declaration could not be read ({0}); other packages are retained.

source: 当前用户的包声明
en: Current-user package declaration

source: 包登录启动声明
en: Packaged logon startup declaration

source: 第三方包的当前启用状态由 Windows 管理，请使用系统启动应用设置。
en: Windows manages the current enabled state of other packages. Use Windows Startup Apps settings.

source: 清单声明 Enabled={0}；这不代表当前启用状态。
en: Manifest declares Enabled={0}; this does not indicate the current enabled state.

source: 未声明
en: not declared

source: 无法确认自启动备份的系统目录或账户。
en: The system backup directory or current account could not be verified.

source: 自启动备份路径包含链接，已停止读取或写入。
en: The startup backup path contains a link; reading or writing has stopped.

source: 自启动备份目录不属于当前账户的受限系统目录。
en: The startup backup directory is outside the current account's protected system location.

source: 自启动备份所有者或权限不可信；原目录权限未被修改。
en: The startup backup owner or permissions are untrusted; existing directory permissions were not changed.

source: 自启动备份必须仅允许管理员和 SYSTEM 访问，未更改现有权限。
en: Startup backups must grant exclusive access to Administrators and SYSTEM; existing permissions were not changed.

source: 自启动备份上级目录可被非管理员替换，已停止操作。
en: A startup backup ancestor can be replaced without administrator privileges; the operation stopped.

source: 启动文件的原始权限或属性无法完整恢复。
en: The startup file's original permissions or attributes could not be fully restored.

source: 启动文件的所有者不支持安全恢复，只能查看。
en: The startup file's owner cannot be restored safely; this entry is read-only.

source: 启动文件含有无法完整恢复的特殊属性，只能查看。
en: The startup file has special attributes that cannot be fully restored; this entry is read-only.

source: 启动文件路径包含链接或已被替换。
en: The startup file path contains a link or has been replaced.
